items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Expected to return for MNF
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) is slated to be activated from IR in time to play in Monday's game against the Bengals, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Dealing with sore toe
items.text:
Head coach Sean McVay said Saturday that Williams is tending to a sore toe but is expected to play Wednesday against the Packers, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports.
